en.title: New Version Available
en.message: A new version of MyConnect is ready. Please update to continue your roleplay.

en.title: March Feature Rollout
en.summary: We are adding new social and roleplay features. Some functions may be briefly unavailable.

updates: Added Group Scene mode for up to 6 participants.
Added quick-reply templates for faster roleplay responses.
Added profile card badges for community milestones.
maintenance_tasks: Migrating scenario metadata to a faster index.
Rebuilding recommendation cache for new character discovery.
bug_fixes: Fixed delayed message delivery in crowded chat rooms.
Fixed occasional image upload failure on iOS.
Fixed login loop after password reset for some accounts.

en.title: Server Maintenance Window
en.summary: Routine infrastructure maintenance is in progress to improve stability.

updates: Most sessions reconnect automatically after maintenance.
bug_fixes: Reduced timeout errors during peak hours.
Improved reconnection handling after temporary disconnects.

en.title: Service Interruption Resolved
en.summary: We are sorry for the unexpected server shutdown earlier today. Service has been restored.

updates: All core chat and roleplay features are now back online.
maintenance_tasks: Replaced a failing node in the message routing cluster.
Added extra failover checks to prevent repeated shutdowns.
bug_fixes: Fixed session drops triggered by restart race conditions.
Fixed stale presence indicators after reconnect.
